notes: Fixed manual evaluation cases for Phase 5.
Each executed case must use the same source version, selection, region, references, prompt and transport parameters for both models.
Status values are not_run, passed or failed; this file defines the cases, not results.

cases.label: Recolor sofa
cases.instruction: Change the sofa upholstery to deep green velvet while preserving its shape, seams and the rest of the room.

cases.label: Replace lamp from a reference
cases.instruction: Replace the floor lamp with the lamp shown in Image 2, matching its shape, material and proportions.

cases.label: Remove wall picture
cases.instruction: Remove the framed picture from the wall and reconstruct the wall surface naturally.

cases.label: Change object material
cases.instruction: Change the coffee table material from wood to brushed metal while preserving its shape and position.

cases.label: Change chair
cases.instruction: Replace the armchair with a modern lounge chair with the same footprint and orientation.
